author: Jason Pieper
text: Brian is there to help. He gets things done correctly and fairly. He’s our professional for our home and business

author: Dee Smith
text: Great company and earned a lifetime customer today.  The technician that came to south mountain gate to service the septic went well beyond his job description in helping identify and remedy our situation.  Very professional and knowledgeable saving us both,  hours and dollars.  Wish we had cash he deserved a tip for sure! A million thanks!

author: c mccanless
text: Pumped a perfectly functioning septic.  Somehow they charged us to pump more gallons than the tank holds, but we were at their mercy, so we paid the $580.00  House went into escrow after sitting empty for 5 months.  Double charged to pump an empty septic tank and send report after telling me that a reinspection was $35, it was $420.  Rep actually said it was a one hour minimum at $150.00, which was enough of a surprise.  Total cost to pump $1000.  Owner made no effort to remedy.  Actually said we were lucky they didn't charge an additional 150.00 for the inspection.

author: Alex Loughran
text: Long story short. I was told a clogged sewer line coming from our residental property would take 4-5 hours of work at $180.00 an hour plus $120.00 call out fee..... so less than $1,000.00. It took Brian four hours to complete and I was charged nearly $3,400.00! Completely manipulative business practices and the owner Steve Poirier nor worker Brian Michaels will own up to their shady ways. After confronting them via telephone they ended the conversation that they will see me in court. PLEASE STAY AWAY!! DO NOT USE BROWN PLUMBING!

author: Cindy Robinson
text: I'm not going to post my same very lengthy review stating the details of exactly how Brown Plumbing completed ripped me off, lied and provided absolutely zero value for $751. Check out my Yelp review if you care to read the story. I learned after the fact that they are well known for ripping people off and charging exhorbitant prices. They are incompetent and dishonest--misdiagnosed more than once and ended up costing me hundreds more with their bad diagnosis. I don't think you could do much worse than them.
